metadata.description: A calm place to talk to someone, by voice, right now.

home.eyebrow: 18+ only · Voice only · No text chat
home.title: Someone to talk to, right now.
home.promise: Enter a shared sky of open people and share a calm voice conversation in under a minute, with no friend requests, no followers and no text feeds.

pillars.voiceBody: Real human conversation with no text messages, DMs or public feeds.
pillars.inviteBody: You are reachable only while Open to talk is on, and you can accept or skip silently.
pillars.safetyBody: End, Leave, Block, Report and "I need help" stay within reach at every moment.

home.crisisDisclaimer: {appName} is a place for companionship and conversation, not a crisis or medical service. If you are in immediate danger, contact your local emergency services.
home.entityNote: Operated by Olystique Ltd. For adults 18 and older.

legal.rulesBody: You must be 18 or older. Treat every person with kindness and respect. Harassment, sexual content, hate speech, scams, impersonation, doxxing and contact with minors result in immediate removal.
legal.privacyBody: Operated by Olystique Ltd. We collect the minimum data needed to run {appName}. Calls and Circles may be recorded server-side for safety moderation and are automatically deleted after the retention window unless attached to an active report or legal hold.
legal.termsBody: Operated by Olystique Ltd. {appName} provides voice companionship and conversation for adults aged 18 and over, and is not a medical, therapy or emergency service.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.body: {appName} needs a connection to find someone to talk to.

presence.not_open: Turn on Open to talk first.

call.already_active: You are already in a call or Circle.

banners.offlineBody: {appName} needs a connection to find someone to talk to.
banners.reconnectingBody: Holding your place for up to {seconds} seconds while your network recovers.
banners.errorBody: We could not reach {appName} right now. Please try again.

helpSheet.title: Need support right now?
helpSheet.companionNotice: {appName} is a place for companionship and conversation, not a crisis or medical service.
helpSheet.emergencyFallback: If you are in immediate danger, contact your local emergency services.

preview.title: {appName} design system preview
preview.subtitle: Calm, warm, human tokens, typography and shared UI primitives across time-of-day palettes and component states.

controls.heading: Appearance and stress controls
controls.longCopyDescription: Expands labels and descriptions to verify layouts never clip or overflow in longer translations.

palettes.heading: Ambient time-of-day palettes (Spec 9.2)
palettes.description: Every colour token is a plain hex value in globals.css meeting WCAG 2.2 AA contrast.
palettes.skyPreview: Living sky backdrop and orb glow
palettes.surfacePreview: Surface card with primary and secondary ink
palettes.secondarySample: Calm conversation, voice only, no pressure.

statuses.heading: Status preset colours and paired icons (Spec 9.2, 9.4)
statuses.description: Every status colour is paired with a distinct icon and text so colour is never the only signal.

typography.heading: Self-hosted typeface and six-language character specimen
typography.description: Self-hosted variable Noto Sans loaded via next/font/local with full coverage for Yoruba, Hausa, Igbo, Nigerian Pidgin, French and English.

buttons.heading: Button and IconButton
buttons.disabled: Call (turn on Open to talk first)
buttons.longPrimary: Enter the shared voice cloud and connect with someone open right now

switches.heading: Switch
switches.openDescription: Visible in the cloud so anyone open can invite you to a voice call.
switches.closedDescription: You can browse the cloud while closed. Turn this on when you want to talk.

inputs.heading: TextField, Select and 6-digit CodeInput
inputs.nameHint: Shown on your profile card in the cloud.
inputs.nameError: Please choose a name between 2 and 24 characters.
inputs.languageHint: Used to match you with people who share your language.
inputs.languageError: Please pick at least one spoken language.
inputs.codeHint: Enter the 6-digit code sent to your email.
inputs.codeError: That code has expired or does not match. Please try again.

chipsAndAvatars.heading: Chip and Avatar (presets and approved photo)
chipsAndAvatars.photoCardLabel: {name}, profile card avatar with approved photo
chipsAndAvatars.photoOrbLabel: {name}, sky orb avatar (photo hidden on orbs per FR-PROF-6)

cardsAndStates.heading: Card, Skeleton and EmptyState
cardsAndStates.cardStandardBody: Photos appear only on the profile card and incoming-call screen, never on sky orbs.
cardsAndStates.cardElevatedBody: Every call is an invitation. Accept or skip silently.
cardsAndStates.emptyBody: Try again in a moment, or turn on Open to talk so others can find you.

feedback.heading: Banner, Toast, Dialog and Sheet
feedback.bannerInfoBody: Turn on Open to talk whenever you are ready to receive voice invitations.
feedback.bannerGoodBody: Voice audio is encrypted and stable.
feedback.bannerCautionBody: Holding the call for up to 15 seconds while your network recovers.
feedback.bannerDangerBody: Check your connection and try again.
feedback.toastNeutralBody: You can call Tolu again whenever they are open to talk.
feedback.toastGoodTitle: You are now open to talk
feedback.toastGoodBody: Your orb is visible in the cloud.
feedback.toastCautionBody: Moving closer to your router may help keep audio smooth.
feedback.toastDangerBody: Allow microphone access in your browser settings to join a voice call.
feedback.dialogTitle: Take over Open to talk on this device?
feedback.dialogDescription: You are already open on another device. Confirming will move your active session here.
feedback.dialogBody: Only one device can be open in the cloud at a time so calls reach the right place.
feedback.sheetDescription: Speaks English and Yorùbá · Happy to listen
feedback.sheetBody: Select Call to send an invitation. If Tolu is unavailable, you will return calmly to the cloud.

appShell.heading: App shell, navigation and always-reachable "I need help" control (Spec 7.7, 9.5, CR-5)
appShell.description: Mobile-first frame with safe-area insets, navigation between Cloud, Recents and Settings, global connection banners, and one-tap reachability to "I need help" from every screen including calls and circles.
appShell.cloudBody: Browse the living sky or tap Find someone for a quick voice match.
appShell.recentsBody: You can call someone from Recents whenever their Open to talk switch is on.
appShell.settingsBody: Control your spoken languages, audio devices and privacy options.
appShell.callHeading: In a voice call with Tolu
appShell.callBody: End, Mute, Block, Report and "I need help" stay on screen for the whole call.
appShell.circleBody: Leave, Mute, Block, Report and "I need help" stay on screen for every member.

landing.heading: Landing page (Spec 7.1, P7, CR-5)
landing.description: One-sentence promise, one primary button ("Enter the cloud"), companion positioning disclaimer, "I need help" reachability, and accessible links to rules, privacy and terms.

cloud.heading: The cloud: sky view, list view and profile card (Spec 9.2, 9.3, FR-CLOUD-3, FR-CLOUD-4, FR-CLOUD-7, FR-PROF-6)
cloud.description: Living sky of softly drifting orbs, accessible list view, profile card sheet, own orb with Open to talk switch, filters and 200-person stress mode.
